confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use aggregated 2025-2026 Bali, Ubud and Canggu price ranges plus a few 2026 menus; beer and cappuccino are best supported. Wine and cocktail values are set against the beer anchor (about 2.8x and 2.7x) and cross-checked against mixed Canggu, Ubud and Bali-wide ranges. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for July peak season, not checked against live listings. Rupiah prices were converted at an assumed 16,500-17,000 IDR per USD, and menu prices may exclude the 21% service and tax common at ++ venues. The FX observation is the only RBA value the single RBA search returned (20 March 2026); it could not be confirmed as the latest value for 19 November 2026 and may be stale. A third-party site showed about 0.70 for late October 2026, which was not used because it is not an RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian resort-town pricing, using Bali-wide aggregates with Ubud and Canggu venue data, and Denpasar benchmarks where Canggu data was thin. Accommodation tiers are model judgement for comparable Bali tourist towns; no single named comparable city was used.
